beginner.title: Get started with Circuit Route Planner
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Circuit Route Planner, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up your business
beginner.outcome: You can: configure Circuit Route Planner for your business
beginner.practice: Set up your profile and three services or products

beginner.title: Daily operations
beginner.outcome: You can: run day-to-day work in Circuit Route Planner
beginner.practice: Run one full day of operations in Circuit Route Planner

intermediate.title: Customers and data
intermediate.outcome: You can: keep clean customer and transaction records
intermediate.practice: Import or clean up your customer list

intermediate.title: Reports that matter
intermediate.outcome: You can: read the reports that guide decisions
intermediate.practice: Review last month's report and pick one action

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Circuit Route Planner
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Circuit Route Planner distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Circuit Route Planner
expert.outcome: You can: use Circuit Route Planner's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Scale and control
expert.outcome: You can: run Circuit Route Planner across a team or branches
expert.practice: Set up roles for staff and review the audit log

expert.title: Integrate Circuit Route Planner into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Circuit Route Planner with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Circuit Route Planner to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Circuit Route Planner well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Circuit Route Planner" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
